prepare_gg_shadow.new:
out << u.mask_color.r
	out << u.mask_color.g
	out << u.mask_color.b
	out << u.mask_color.a

inv_dimensions: [f32(1) / f32(layer.texture_width), f32(1) / f32(layer.texture_height)]!
			mask_color: layer.mask_color

prepare_gg_image.new: bindings.fs.samplers[0] = if draw.texture.document_linear_filter { document_image_sampler() } else { ctx.layer_sampler() }

prepare_gg_yuv.new:
out << u.color_transform.gamma
	out << if u.color_transform.yuv_rec601_limited { f32(1) } else { f32(0) }

prepare_gg_yuv_atlas_uniform.old:
out << if u.color_transform.yuv_rec601_limited { f32(1) } else { f32(0) }
	out << 0
prepare_gg_yuv_atlas_uniform.new:
out << if u.color_transform.yuv_rec601_limited { f32(1) } else { f32(0) }
	out << if u.color_transform.yuv420_atlas { f32(1) } else { f32(0) }

prepare_gg_jpeg_uniform.old:
out << if u.color_transform.yuv420_atlas { f32(1) } else { f32(0) }
	out << 0
prepare_gg_jpeg_uniform.new:
out << if u.color_transform.yuv420_atlas { f32(1) } else { f32(0) }
	out << if u.color_transform.yuv_jpeg_full { f32(1) } else { f32(0) }
